postconditions.condition: The burn area is clear of the old dressing material.

review_notes: Visual verification limited to the absence of the old dressing covering the burn site.
Excluded the 'gently' requirement as it is a subjective manner of operation not verifiable via a single image.
Manual completion is false as the removal state is visually verifiable.
A4 is treated as the removal step; postcondition verifies the dressing is no longer present on the burn site.
